$comment: Per-meter model: a live service on one branch (master) with several sessions a day. The runner commits below HOLD and the main session at HOLD or on the owner's ask; only the pusher or the main session pushes. Usage is judged per meter: the session meter strands in-flight agents when it hits its cap, so it holds earlier than the weekly one, which runs down slowly. Legacy docs folders are exempt from the cap and the index check.
